name: Cronus
description: A Tempo/Cooldown/Control Support who manipulates fight tempo by debuffing enemy skill rotations, doubling allied active casts, saving near-death allies via time rewind, and projecting temporary copies of allied heroes into battle.

skills.name: Temporal Vortex
skills.description: Summons a Temporal Vortex that deals 280% ATK DMG to all enemy units, reducing their ATK SPD and Move SPD by 100% for 5s.

upgrades.level2: Also increases enemy active skill CD by 5 seconds for enemies within the area.
upgrades.level4: Affected enemies cannot regenerate Energy naturally during the effect duration.

skills.name: Temporal Rift
skills.description: Cronus teleports the nearest enemy to the position of the farthest enemy, dealing 180% ATK DMG to both targets and Stunning them for 2 seconds.

upgrades.level3: Each time an allied unit casts an Active Skill, the CD of this skill is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: Rewinding Remains
skills.description: When an allied unit is about to fall, Cronus rewinds that unit to its optimal state from the past 5 seconds. After the rewind, the target's ATK and ATK SPD are reduced by 90% for 2s. This skill has 18s CD.

upgrades.level3: When Cronus is about to fall, this effect triggers once for free on himself.

skills.name: Echo of Causality
skills.description: At the start of battle, mark the allied unit with the highest CD Reduction as [Time Traveler]. When the Time Traveler casts an Active Skill (excluding Ultimate and Entry Skill), that skill is cast again immediately. This effect has 20s CD.

upgrades.level3: At the start of battle, reduce the initial CD of all allied units by 5s.

relic.name: Doctrine of Time
relic.description: Every 15 seconds, Cronus cyclically projects a Translucent Echo of a teammate into the battle for 6 seconds. Projection priority: Time Traveler first, then allied units from highest to lowest ATK. The Projection inherits 50% of Cronus's ATK and Max HP, and all skills of the projected unit. The projected unit's character and skill levels scale with Cronus's level.

upgrades.level2: Upon entering the battlefield, the Translucent Echo refreshes all skill CDs. [Relic Lv.10]
upgrades.level3: Translucent Echo duration is increased to 10s. [Relic Lv.20]
upgrades.level4: Translucent Echo gains 1000 Energy upon entering battle.

coreMechanic.summary: Best support in game -- complete CC, complete support, full-map coverage. Full kit unlocked at base dupe. Delayed ultimate release requires precise timing control.

strengths: AoE anti-tempo Ultimate reduces enemy ATK Speed, delays active skills, and blocks Energy regeneration - three distinct debuff layers in one cast
Temporal Rift is Formation Break plus Double Stun - very effective against backline-dependent and positioning-reliant compositions
Rewinding Remains provides a save mechanic that restores an ally's full state, not just HP - Energy and buffs are preserved at the prior snapshot
Echo of Causality doubles one ally's active skill every rotation - a consistent, passive damage and utility multiplier that requires no execution overhead
Projection system creates a second temporary version of a key ally - at Relic Lv2 paired with a CD reset, this amounts to a second full team rotation
Temporal Rift Lv3 self-accelerates on cast frequency - the more your team plays actively, the faster formation disruption returns
Scales with team quality: the stronger the ally designated as Time Traveler or projected, the higher Cronus's multiplier output
weaknesses: Not a top pick for pure single-target boss DPS races where tempo manipulation and formation disruption are irrelevant
Value scales with ally quality - if the carry pool is weak, Cronus loses significant multiplier output
Relic-dependent: without Relic Lv2 the Projection system lacks its defining CD reset; without Lv4 the projection's impact is delayed
Against raw stat-check teams that simply overwhelm utility through damage output, Cronus's kit cannot compensate for large stat disparities alone
Rewinding Remains reduces the saved target's ATK and ATK Speed after triggering - the saved ally is temporarily weakened following the rescue window
